description:
A linked checkout with a deliberately diverged store proves the divergence report and the
lossless recovery procedure from the boundary an adopter invokes.

## Background

The reported field incident ended with issue and event history recoverable only from a
dangling commit. No artefact of that repository is preserved anywhere, so the reproduction is
built rather than restored: a test-created linked checkout diverges its store on purpose, and
the check and the documented procedure are then exercised exactly as an adopter would run
them.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: After a mutation inside the linked checkout, the divergence check run from the primary reports the diverged issue records and the disjoint events, and reports nothing once the two stores agree.
- [hard] REQ-02: The documented recovery procedure applied to that reproduction yields one store holding both checkouts' issue records and both event histories, with neither side overwritten.
- [hard] REQ-03: The coverage lands as modules of an existing test target and keeps the suite inside the repository's measured budgets.
title: Divergence and recovery journey
